composites.name: glycolysis_monolithic
composites.description: Arm 1: whole 17-species glycolysis model in one TelluriumProcess (accuracy reference, bulk-bound species port).

composites.name: glycolysis_operator_split
composites.description: Arm 2: the 17-species glycolysis model integrated as a Lie operator split — core glycolytic/fermentation network vs. the glycogen/trehalose storage sinks — exchanging the full species state through a shared vivarium store each coupling interval (same biology as arm 1).

composites.name: glycolysis_modular
composites.description: Arm 3: the 17-species glycolysis model partitioned along the biological aldolase seam into separate upper- and lower-glycolysis process nodes (one SubmodelProcess each) that share a single species store and couple only through it — each writes its per-interval deltas, which reconcile additively through the bigraph apply path (same biology as arm 1).

composites.name: glycolysis_native_scalar
composites.description: Arm 4 (scalar leaf): the 17-species Teusink glycolysis ODE network reimplemented as a fully native process-bigraph process — hand-ported rate laws, explicit scipy (LSODA) integration, no libroadrunner at runtime — with the species state carried as a map[float] (17 float leaves), the same leaf shape as arms 1-3.

composites.name: glycolysis_native_array
composites.description: Arm 4 (array leaf): the SAME fully native Teusink glycolysis ODE network as glycolysis_native_scalar — identical hand-ported RHS and scipy (LSODA) integration — but with the species state carried as ONE numpy array leaf instead of 17 scalar map leaves, isolating the bigraph framework tax attributable purely to state shape.

composites.name: glycolysis_coupled
composites.description: Arm 6 (coupling demonstration): arm 3's modular glycolysis decomposition with the lower-glycolysis submodel swapped for a NATIVE process-bigraph process (hand-ported Teusink RHS + scipy) while upper glycolysis stays a Tellurium/libroadrunner submodel — two different simulation engines sharing one species store and reconciling additively. A composition a single monolithic SBML/libroadrunner model structurally cannot express (it solves the same ODEs, reproducing arm 3 to ~1e-7; the impossibility is structural, not numeric), and which is kept off the accuracy axis as the composability existence proof.
methods: native Python/numpy Teusink RHS + scipy LSODA (lower submodel)

composites.name: glycolysis_multirate
composites.description: Arm 7 (multi-rate scheduler stress test): N INDEPENDENT monolithic glycolysis instances (each the arm-1 whole-model TelluriumProcess, bulk-bound species), each advanced on a DIFFERENT geometrically-spaced coupling interval. No shared store and no coupling, so there is no operator-splitting error — the point is to exercise process-bigraph's temporal scheduler (#270's event-heap: O(P log P) vs the stock scan's O(P^2) on many-rate composites), whose scan/heap results are bit-identical.
methods: N independent libroadrunner/CVODE monolith instances (arm 1 per node)
process-bigraph #270 event-heap temporal scheduler (O(P log P))

composites.name: glycolysis_multiorgan_mono
composites.description: Arm 8 (monolithic): the whole N-organ synthetic body as ONE Antimony/Tellurium model integrated by a single libroadrunner/CVODE instance. The scaling knob (N organs, species=3N+1, reactions=4N) is what strains — the libroadrunner model build is superlinear in reactions. config.model carries the N-organ Antimony so the Model page can show it.
methods: single libroadrunner/CVODE instance over the whole N-organ body

composites.name: glycolysis_multiorgan_decomposed
composites.description: Arm 8 (decomposed): the N-organ body as N per-organ OrganProcess nodes, each its own small libroadrunner instance, coupled through ONE shared blood store — every organ writes its per-interval Glc_blood delta, which reconcile additively through the bigraph apply path (arm-3 pattern). Builds N small models (one libroadrunner setup per organ) instead of one giant one — a structural build-vs-run trade, not a guaranteed speed win.
methods: N per-organ libroadrunner/CVODE instances (one reaction-subset each)
shared blood store, additive Glc_blood delta coupling (bigraph apply path)

composites.name: predator_prey_abm
composites.description: Arm 9 (ABM): a well-mixed stochastic Lotka-Volterra predator-prey model as a population of DISCRETE individuals with stochastic birth/predation/death events, advanced by the exact Gillespie SSA in a native process-bigraph process. Integer-count state, one stochastic trajectory per run. This is the model that is NOT an SBML/ODE model — the adversarial case for the 'any model is an SBML model' claim.

composites.name: predator_prey_meanfield
composites.description: Arm 9 (mean-field reduction): the deterministic Lotka-Volterra ODE as Antimony integrated by libroadrunner/CVODE in a TelluriumProcess — the SBML reduction of the stochastic ABM. Faithful only in the large-population, well-mixed, deterministic limit; it structurally cannot represent the ABM's stochasticity, discreteness, or extinction.
